why_the_bar_is_the_75th_and_not_the_medi: a page admitted on what it can say rather than on who reads it should say MORE than the pages admitted on readers, not the same amount. The median reading is defensible and is counted here rather than argued about.
utility_bar_basis: the 75th percentile of the printable-fact count among the 143704 rows admitted on readership alone in this same run
why_other_languages_are_not_taken: one page per entity. The same landmark in ten editions is ten translations of one page, and this inventory does not build those.
